description: Cash and store-credit totals for up to 25 items someone wants to sell. Name each item, its platform and its condition; NOSTOS prices every line itself, reports any it isn't buying, and says whether the free prepaid label applies and whether the basket goes to a personal review. An estimate that saves nothing.

items.description: Up to 25 items to sell. NOSTOS prices each one itself; there is no price to pass in.

condition.description: loose, cib (complete in box), boxgame (Box & Game, no manual) or new (sealed).

platform.description: Console, e.g. 'Nintendo 64', 'N64', 'PS2', 'Super Famicom'. Required: the same title on two consoles is priced differently.

name: get_trade_in_offer_estimate
title: Trade-in offer estimate
